name: MetroPT2: A Benchmark Dataset for Predictive Maintenance
summary: A 1 Hz multivariate time series from a metro-train air production unit, with analogue and digital sensor signals and documented air- and oil-leak intervals.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Observation time for measurements logged at 1 Hz.

attributes.name: analogue sensors
attributes.description: Pressure, motor-current, oil-temperature, flowmeter, GPS, and related analogue measurements.

attributes.name: digital signals
attributes.description: Control and discrete signals including air-intake-valve states.

attributes.name: failure interval
attributes.description: Air-leak and oil-leak intervals documented by the provider outside the CSV labels.

notes: The current version contains about 7.1 million observations and 21 attributes.
The source CSV is unlabeled; task targets must be derived from the two provider-documented failure intervals.
The 1.2 GB CSV is opt-in and is not downloaded by scripts/bootstrap.sh.
citation: Veloso, B., Gama, J., Ribeiro, R. and Pereira, P. (2023). MetroPT2: A Benchmark dataset for predictive maintenance. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7766691
